profile.name: Wells Fargo & Company
profile.summary: Wells Fargo & Company, a financial services company, provides diversified banking, investment, mortgage, and consumer and commercial finance products and services in the United States and internationally. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking and Lending; Commercial Banking; Corporate and Investment Banking; and Wealth and Investment Management. The company's financial products and services includes checking and savings accounts, and credit and debit cards, as well as home, auto, personal, and small business lending services. It also provides personalized wealth management, brokerage, financial planning, lending, private banking, trust and fiduciary products and services; and financial solutions to private, family owned and public companies through products and services including banking and credit products across multiple industry sectors and municipalities, secured lending and lease products, and treasury management. In addition, it offers a suite of capital markets, banking, and financial products and services, such as corporate banking, investment banking, treasury management, commercial real estate lending and servicing, equity, and fixed income solutions, as well as sales, trading, and research capabilities services to corporate, commercial real estate, government, and institutional clients. Wells Fargo & Company was founded in 1852 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

trends.claim: Credit card balance growth is forecast to slow to 2.3% year over year in 2026, the smallest increase since 2013.
trends.why: Slower card balance growth limits interest and fee revenue growth in Consumer Banking and Lending.
trends.quote: credit card balances to grow 2.3% year over year (YoY)—the smallest annual increase since 2013
trends.size_basis: Balances expected to reach $1.18 trillion by end 2026.
trends.impact_basis: Credit cards are a major part of Consumer Banking and Lending.
trends.theme_definition: Credit card balances are growing more slowly as lenders tighten underwriting and consumers manage debt.

trends.claim: Mortgage and unsecured personal loan originations are projected to drive consumer credit expansion in 2026.
trends.why: Higher mortgage and personal loan originations support loan growth and fee income in Consumer Banking.
trends.quote: mortgage and unsecured personal loans as the primary drivers of projected expansion.
trends.impact_basis: Mortgages and personal loans are core Consumer Banking products.
trends.theme_definition: Mortgage and personal loan originations are rebounding, driving consumer credit expansion after prior lows.

trends.claim: Banks tightened C&I lending standards for firms of all sizes in Q4 2025, per the January 2026 Fed survey.
trends.why: Tighter standards can slow commercial loan growth and related fee income at WFC's Commercial Banking unit.
trends.quote: tighter lending standards for commercial and industrial (C&I) loans to firms of all sizes
trends.impact_basis: C&I lending is core to Commercial Banking.
trends.theme_definition: Banks are tightening credit standards for commercial and industrial loans across firm sizes.

trends.claim: Large and middle-market firms showed stronger C&I loan demand in Q4 2025, while small-firm demand was unchanged.
trends.why: Higher commercial loan demand supports loan growth and net interest income in Commercial Banking.
trends.quote: stronger demand for C&I loans to large and middle-market firms
trends.impact_basis: C&I lending is core to Commercial Banking.
trends.theme_definition: Large and middle-market firms are seeking more commercial and industrial loans, supporting bank lending.

trends.claim: Middle-market borrowers expect revenue growth and margin expansion in 2026, supporting credit demand.
trends.why: Healthier middle-market borrowers can sustain loan demand and lower credit losses for Commercial Banking.
trends.quote: Most expect revenue growth in 2026, with an even stronger outlook for EBITDA growth and margin expansion.
trends.impact_basis: Middle-market lending is core to Commercial Banking.
trends.theme_definition: Middle-market borrowers are confident in revenue and margin growth, supporting bank credit demand.

trends.claim: Global M&A volumes rose 48% year over year in the first half of 2026, led by mega deals.
trends.why: Higher M&A volumes boost advisory and capital markets fee revenue in Corporate and Investment Banking.
trends.size_basis: Global M&A volumes rose 48% YoY in 1H 2026.
trends.impact_basis: M&A advisory is a major CIB revenue stream.
trends.theme_definition: Global mergers and acquisitions activity is rebounding strongly, boosting investment banking fees.

trends.claim: Falling-rate benefits are fading, with less room to cut funding costs and loan repricing pressuring spread income in 2026.
trends.why: Narrower net interest margin reduces net interest income, a core driver of total revenue.
trends.quote: less room to further reduce funding costs, while continued repricing of loans and other earning assets is likely to increase pressure on spread income
trends.speed_basis: Article July 2026 says nearly two years into falling-rate cycle.
trends.impact_basis: Net interest income is a core driver of total revenue.
trends.theme_definition: Banks face shrinking net interest margins as funding costs stop falling and loan yields reprice lower.

trends.claim: Domestic deposits rose for the eighth consecutive quarter and loan growth was strong in Q2 2026.
trends.why: Deposit and loan growth support balance sheet expansion and net interest income across the bank.
trends.quote: Domestic deposits increased for the eighth consecutive quarter and loan growth was strong.
trends.impact_basis: Deposits and loans are core to total revenue.
trends.theme_label: US banking deposit and loan growth
trends.theme_definition: US banks are seeing sustained deposit inflows and strong loan growth, supporting balance sheets.

trends.claim: Banks are rethinking branch consolidation as branches prove their relationship value in 2026.
trends.why: Branch relationships can lift deposit and wealth revenue but may raise distribution costs.
trends.quote: Banks are rethinking branch consolidation as branches prove their relationship value
trends.impact_basis: Branch channel affects Consumer Banking and Wealth.
trends.theme_definition: Banks are re-evaluating branch closures as physical locations prove valuable for relationships.

trends.claim: SMB switching intent is rising, with commercial customers preparing to switch banks at unprecedented rates in 2026.
trends.why: Higher switching risk threatens deposit retention and fee revenue in Commercial Banking.
trends.quote: Commercial Customers Are Preparing to Switch at Unprecedented Rates
trends.impact_basis: SMB banking is part of Commercial Banking.
trends.theme_definition: Small and midsize businesses are increasingly willing to switch banks for better functionality.

trends.claim: Annual direct mortgage servicing costs rose to $185 per loan in 2025 from $181 in 2024.
trends.why: Higher servicing costs per loan compress margins on mortgage servicing in Consumer Banking.
trends.quote: annual direct servicing costs averaged $185 per loan in 2025, an increase from $181 per loan in 2024.
trends.size_basis: $4 per loan increase, no total magnitude.
trends.impact_basis: Mortgage servicing is part of Consumer Banking.
trends.theme_definition: Mortgage servicing costs per loan are rising due to compliance and operational demands.

trends.claim: CIB revenue momentum is slowing in 2026, with non-banks and fintechs scaling competition.
trends.why: Slower CIB revenue growth and non-bank competition pressure fees and market share.
trends.quote: The industry is still on a growth trajectory, but the momentum we’ve seen in recent years is starting to level off.
trends.impact_basis: CIB is a major revenue stream.
trends.theme_definition: Corporate and investment banking revenue growth is slowing as non-bank competitors scale.
